data.title: Jordi Visser Says One Overlooked Event Could Help Bitcoin Break Out Of Its Slump
data.description: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser said next week's U.S. Treasury refinancing announcement could ease the pressure on Bitcoin (BTC), gold and artificial intelligence (AI) stocks this year.Speaking on Anthony Pompliano's podcast on Friday, Visser said high real interest rates have been the main drag o…
